blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This work presents SplatFlux, a feed-forward latent-to-4DGS framework for both video-based 4D reconstruction and conditional 4D generation. Our key observation is that observed videos and conditionally generated content can be represented in the same pretrained video latent space, allowing both tasks to be formulated as latent-to-4DGS decoding. To construct compact and temporally coherent 4D scenes, SplatFlux introduces a static-dynamic decoupled 4D Gaussian representation that explicitly predicts dynamic probabilities for Gaussian primitives. This representation separates static scene structures from moving regions, enabling complete 4D scene construction in a feed-forward manner through static aggregation and dynamic motion interpolation. To learn static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic Gaussian motion without costly annotations, we further develop an auxiliary distillation strategy that provides pseudo dynamic masks and optical-flow cues. Extensive experiments across 3D and 4D reconstruction and generation demonstrate that SplatFlux achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 这部作品呈现了SplatFlux,它是一个供基于视频的4D重建以及有条件的4D生成的Feed-forward潜在到4DGS框架. 我们的主要观察是,可观察到的视频和有条件生成的内容可以被表现在同一预先训练的视频潜在空间,使得这两个任务都能够被设定为潜在到4DGS解码. 为了构建紧凑和时间上连贯的4D场景,斯柏特福卢斯引入了静态动力解耦的4D高斯代表,明确预测了高斯原始人的动态概率. 这种表示方式将静态场景结构与移动区域区分开来,通过静态聚合和动态运动内插,使得4D场景建筑能够以向反馈的方式完成. 为了学习静态动力分解和动态高斯运动而无需花费高昂的注释,我们进一步发展了辅助蒸馏策略,提供伪动态口罩和光学流提示. 跨越3D和4D的重建与生成的广泛实验证明,SplateFlux实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reconstructing and synthesizing dynamic 3D worlds is essential for filmmaking, VR/AR, and physical AI systems grounded in closed-loop simulation ( Bahmani et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wen et al., 2025 ) . Recent feed-forward geometry and depth models ( Wang et al., 2025c ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2025e ; Wang et al., 2024 ) demonstrate that rich 3D information can be inferred directly from visual observations. Building on this progress, feed-forward 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) methods ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Hur et al., 2026 ) have emerged to predict temporally coherent Gaussian primitives for efficient dynamic scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 重建和合成动态3D世界对电影制作、VR/AR和基于闭路模拟的物理AI系统至关重要(Bahmani等人,2026年;Pan等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年a); Wang等人,2025a;Wen等人,2025). 近代的饲料前方几何和深度模型(Wang等人,2025c;Lin等人,2026c;Wang等人,2026c;Wang等人,2025e;Wang等人,2024)证明,丰富的3D信息可以从视觉观测直接推断出来. 在这一进展的基础上,出现了向导4D高斯镀(4DGS)方法(徐等人,2025b;杨等人,2026;梁等人,2024;林等人,2025a;胡尔等人,2026),以预测时间上一致的高斯原始物,以高效的动态场景重建和新景合成.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, most existing feed-forward 4DGS approaches ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Hur et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025b ) are developed for reconstructing dynamic scenes from observed videos. In parallel, modern video generative models ( Team, 2024 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) can synthesize high-quality video latents from user conditions, providing conditionally generated dynamic visual content in the video latent domain. These advances suggest a latent-domain formulation of 4DGS, where both captured videos and generated content can be represented as video latent sequences before being decoded into dynamic Gaussian representations.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这一进展,但现有的大多数向导4DGS方法(徐等人,2025年b;林等人,2025年a); 杨等,2026; 梁等. 2024; Hur et al., 2026; Wu et al., 2025b)是为从被观测到的视频中重建动态场景而开发的. 同时,现代视频基因模型(Team, 2024;Kong等人, 2024;Wan等人, 2025;Yang等人, 2024)可以合成来自用户条件的高质量视频潜伏,在视频潜伏领域提供有条件生成的动态视觉内容. 这些进步表明4DGS的潜域配制,在解码为动态高斯表达之前,可以将捕获的视频和生成的内容作为视频潜伏序列来表示.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, a key challenge lies in separating and representing static and dynamic components within a complete 4D scene. Existing feed-forward 4DGS approaches often separate static and dynamic components indirectly, through temporal lifespan modeling ( Xu et al., 2025b ) , tracking-based post-processing ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , or motion-induced displacement prediction ( Lin et al., 2025a ) . Such implicit formulations may entangle moving objects with static scene structures, especially under complex motion and occlusion.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,一个关键的挑战在于在一个完整的4D场景中分离和代表静态和动态的组件. 现有的向导4DGS方法往往通过时间寿命模型(徐等人,2025年b),基于跟踪的后处理(杨等人,2026年),或运动引起的迁移预测(林等人,2025年a)间接地将静态和动态成分分离. 这种隐含的配体可能用静态场景结构缠绕移动物体,特别是在复杂的运动和隐蔽下.

blocks.en: In this work, we present SplatFlux , a feed-forward latent-to-4DGS framework for both video-based reconstruction and conditional 4D generation. Our key observation is that observed videos and conditionally generated content can be represented in the same pretrained video latent space ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . Observed videos are compressed into latent sequences by the VAE encoder, while conditional generation directly produces latent sequences in this space. This common latent representation allows both tasks to be formulated as a unified latent-to-4DGS decoding problem, enabling a shared decoder to map video latents from different sources into dynamic Gaussian representations.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们呈现了SplateFlux(SplateFlux),这是一个供视频重建和有条件的4D生成的Feed-forward潜在到4DGS框架. 我们的主要观察是,可观测到的视频和有条件生成的内容可以出现在同一个预先训练好的视频潜在空间(Wan等人,2025年)。 被观测到的视频被VAE编码器压缩成潜伏序列,而有条件的生成则在此空间直接产生潜伏序列. 这种共同的潜伏表示使两个任务都能够被设定为统一的潜伏到4DGS解码问题,使一个共享的解码器能够将来自不同来源的视频潜伏图映射到动态的高斯表示.

blocks.en: Beyond this task-level unification, SplatFlux further addresses the representation-level ambiguity between static scene structures and moving regions. Instead of inducing static-dynamic separation implicitly from temporal cues, we introduce a static-dynamic decoupled 4D Gaussian representation by explicitly predicting dynamic probabilities for Gaussian primitives. This explicit representation enables complete 4D scene construction in a feed-forward manner without relying on any post-processing. To learn static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic Gaussian motion without costly annotations, we adopt an auxiliary distillation strategy . Specifically, we supervise dynamic probabilities with pseudo dynamic masks generated by vision-language-guided segmentation ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) , and constrain dynamic Gaussian motion using pseudo optical-flow labels ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) . These complementary signals provide scalable supervision for explicit static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic motion learning.
blocks.zh: 除了这种任务层面的统一之外,SplatFlux还进一步解决了静态场景结构与移动区域之间的代表性层面模糊. 我们没有从时间提示中暗示诱导静态动力分离,而是通过明确预测高斯原始人的动态概率,引入静态动力解析4D高斯代表. 这种明确的表示方式使得4D场景能够以向上传输的方式完成施工,而无需依赖任何后处理. 为了学习静态动力分解和动态高斯运动, 我们采用了辅助蒸馏策略。 具体来说,我们用视觉语言导线分解产生的伪动态口罩监督动态概率(Bai等人,2025年;Yuan等人,2025年),并使用伪光学流标签限制动态高斯运动(Zhang等人,2025年c). 这些互补信号为清晰的静动分解和动态运动学习提供了可伸缩的监管.

blocks.en: We evaluate SplatFlux across 3D and 4D reconstruction and generation tasks. Experiments demonstrate that SplatFlux achieves state-of-the-art results. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们通过3D和4D的重建和生成任务来评估SplatFlux. 实验证明SplatFlux实现了最先进的结果. 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose SplatFlux, a feed-forward latent-to-4DGS framework that decodes video latents from different sources into 4D Gaussian representations, supporting both video-based 4D reconstruction and conditional 4D generation. • We introduce a static-dynamic decoupled 4D Gaussian representation through explicit dynamic probability estimation, enabling compact and complete 4D scene construction in a feed-forward manner. • We develop an auxiliary distillation strategy that uses vision-language-guided dynamic masks and optical-flow cues to learn static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic Gaussian motion without costly annotations. • Extensive experiments across 3D and 4D reconstruction and generation tasks demonstrate that SplatFlux achieves state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议使用SplateFlux,这是一个向导的潜伏到4DGS框架,将不同来源的视频潜伏解码为4D高斯表示,支持基于视频的4D重建和有条件的4D生成. ^ 我们通过明确的动态概率估计,采用静态-动力解析4D高斯代表,使4D场景的构造能够紧凑和以馈送方式完成。 我们开发了辅助蒸馏策略,使用视觉语言导动口罩和光学流动提示来学习静态动力分解和动态高斯运动,而无需昂贵的说明. • 跨越3D和4D重建和发电任务的广泛实验表明,SplatFlux达到了最先进的性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D/4D Reconstruction and Novel View Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维/4D 重建和小说视图合成

blocks.en: Traditional approaches typically rely on costly per-scene optimization, including classical structure-from-motion (SfM) ( Schonberger and Frahm, 2016 ) , neural radiance fields (NeRF) ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ) , and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) . Several methods ( Wang et al., 2025d ; Sun et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Lei et al., 2025 ) further extend 3DGS to dynamic scenes through temporal deformation modeling and additional supervision estimated from vision foundation models. With the growth of large-scale 3D datasets and foundation models ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ; Ranftl et al., 2021 ) , feed-forward 3D and 4D reconstruction approaches ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Leroy et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025f ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025e ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Hu et al., 2025b ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Yu et al., 2026a ) have become increasingly prominent. Methods such as DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025c ) directly predict dense geometry and camera parameters from images, while approaches ( Ye et al., 2025a ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) like AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) predict 3D Gaussian primitives for novel view synthesis in static scenes.
blocks.zh: 传统方法一般依赖于成本高昂的人均场景优化,包括古典结构自运动(SfM)(Schonberger和Frahm,2016年),神经辐射场(NERF)(Mildenhall等人,2020年),以及3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)(Kerbl等人,2023年). 几种方法(Wang等人,2025d;Sun等人,2024b;Wang等人,2026b;Lei等人,2025)通过时间变形模型和从视觉基础模型估计的额外监督,进一步将3DGS扩展到动态场景. 随着大型3D数据集和基础模型的成长(Dosovitskiy等人,2020年;Oquab等人,2023年;Siméoni等人,2025年;Ranftl等人,2021年),饲料3D和4D重建方法(Wang等人,2024年;Leroy等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025f年;Wang等人,2026c年;Lin等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025c年;Fang等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年;Yu等人,2026b;Zhang等人,2025a;Wang等人,2025e;Chen等人,2025b;Wang等人,2025b;Hu等人,2025b;Wen等人,2025c;Wang等人,2026a;Yu等人,2026a。 DUST3R(Wang等人,2024年)和VGGT(Wang等人,2025年c)等方法直接预测来自图像的密集几何学和相机参数,而方法则接近(Ye等人,2025年a; Ye等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b) 类似AnySplate(Jiang等人,2025年)预测3D高斯原始物在静态场景中进行小说景观合成.

blocks.en: For feed-forward dynamic novel view synthesis, recent methods such as L4GM ( Ren et al., 2024 ) , STORM ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , 4DGT ( Xu et al., 2025b ) , MoVieS ( Lin et al., 2025a ) , DGS-LRM ( Lin et al., 2025b ) , and BTimer ( Liang et al., 2024 ) estimate motion-related attributes for Gaussian primitives. However, most of these approaches still assume posed inputs, and MoVieS ( Lin et al., 2025a ) and BTimer ( Liang et al., 2024 ) further require additional network inference for rendering at each target timestamp. UFO-4D ( Hur et al., 2026 ) relaxes the pose requirement, but is limited to two input views. NeoVerse ( Yang et al., 2026 ) supports unposed video inputs, yet relies on hand-crafted global motion tracking to aggregate a scene-level representation. These limitations highlight the need for a feed-forward framework that can infer a complete dynamic Gaussian representation from unposed monocular videos, without per-timestamp network inference or hand-crafted post-processing.
blocks.zh: 对于feed-forward动态小说视图合成,近代方法如L4GM(Ren等人,2024年),STORM(Yang等人,2025a),4DGT(Xu等人,2025b),MOVieS(Lin等人,2025a),DGS-LRM(Lin等人,2025b),BTimer(Liang等人,2024年)估计高斯原始人的运动相关属性. 然而,大多数这些方法仍然假定提供了投入,而MoVieS(Lin等人,2025a)和BTimer(Liang等人,2024年)进一步要求在每个目标时间戳进行渲染需要额外的网络推论. UFO-4D(Hur等人,2026年)放宽了姿势要求,但仅限于两个输入视图. NeoVerse(Yang等人,2026年)支持未置放的视频输入,然而却依靠手工全球运动跟踪来聚合场景级代表. 这些局限性凸显出需要一种向导框架,可以推断出一个完整的动态高斯式代表来自无位单视视频,没有时标网络推论或手制后处理.

blocks.en: 2.2 3D/4D Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 3D/4D 生成

blocks.en: Recent 3D and 4D generative approaches have made notable progress by distilling or fine-tuning pretrained image and video diffusion models ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . The pioneering work DreamFusion ( Poole et al., 2022 ) introduces score distillation sampling (SDS) to optimize 3D representations by distilling gradients from pretrained diffusion models. Subsequent methods ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Singer et al., 2023 ; Bahmani et al., 2024a ; Bahmani et al., 2024b ) improve the distillation objective or extend this paradigm to 4D scene generation.
blocks.zh: 近期的3D和4D基因方法通过蒸馏或微调预试图像和视频传播模型取得了显著进展(Saharia等人,2022年;Rombach等人,2022年;Wan等人,2025年;Yang等人,2024年)。 开创性的工作DreamFusion(Poole等人,2022年)引入了分数蒸馏取样(SDS),通过从预先训练的传播模型中蒸馏梯度来优化3D表示. 随后的方法(Wang等人,2023年;Singer等人,2023年;Bahmani等人,2024年a;Bahmani等人,2024年b)改进蒸馏目标或将这一范式扩展到4D场景生成.

blocks.en: Another line of work ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Szymanowicz et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024a ; Go et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Cai et al., 2025 ) combines generative diffusion priors with 3D reconstruction for efficient 3D scene generation. Approaches such as CAT3D ( Gao et al., 2024 ) and SEVA ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) first synthesize multi-view images with diffusion models, followed by 3D reconstruction. In contrast, other methods ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Go et al., 2025b ; Go et al., 2025a ) bypass explicit RGB multi-view synthesis, and directly decode latent features into 3D Gaussian primitives. To support 4D content generation, some approaches ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2024 ) generate synchronized multi-view videos, while others extend video generation to dynamic point maps ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Park et al., 2025 ) . Recent methods such as Lyra ( Bahmani et al., 2026 ) and Diff4Splat ( Pan et al., 2025 ) further explore dynamic Gaussian generation. However, they rely on target-time Gaussian prediction mechanisms, as in BTimer ( Liang et al., 2024 ) and MoVieS ( Lin et al., 2025a ) , where rendering a new timestamp requires additional network inference to obtain the corresponding Gaussian state. In contrast, SplatFlux formulates conditional 4D generation as latent-to-4DGS decoding, and directly produces a complete 4DGS representation that supports continuous-time rendering without per-timestamp network inference.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作(Tang等人,2024年;Szymanowicz等人,2025年;Gao等人,2024年;Sun等人,2024年a;Go等人,2025年b;Zhou等人,2025年a); Yang等人,2025b;Cai等人,2025)将基因传播前科与3D重建相结合,高效的3D场景生成. CAT3D(Gao等人,2024年)和SEVA(Zhou等人,2025年a)等方法首先用扩散模型合成多视图图像,然后进行3D重建. 相比之下,其他方法(Yang等人,2025年b; Cai等人,2025年;Go等人,2025年b;Go等人,2025年a)绕过明显的RGB多视图合成,直接将潜伏特征解码为3D高斯原始. 支持4D内容生成,一些方法(Wang等人,2025a); Wu等人,2025a; Xie等人,2024年)生成同步多视图视频,而其他人则将视频生成扩展到动态点图(Zhu等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年c;Park等人,2025年). 近代方法如Lyra(Bahmani等人,2026年)和Diff4Splat(Pan等人,2025年)进一步探索动态高斯一代. 然而,它们依赖于目标时间高斯预测机制,例如在BTimer(Liang等人,2024年)和MoVieS(Lin等人,2025年a年)中,做出新的时间戳需要额外的网络推论以获得相应的高斯状态. 相比之下,SplatFlux则将有条件的4D生成作为潜在到4DGS的解码,并直接产生完整的4DGS代表,支持连续的渲染而无需时标网络推论.

blocks.zh: 3.4 示范培训

blocks.en: Learning static-dynamic decomposition and dynamic Gaussian motion would benefit from direct supervision with dynamic masks and motion labels. However, such annotations are costly to obtain, and are typically limited to small-scale synthetic datasets ( Karaev et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) . Relying only on rendering losses provides weak constraints on dynamic probabilities and local velocities, often leading to ambiguous decomposition and inaccurate motion estimation.
blocks.zh: 学习静态动力分解和动态高斯运动将受益于带有动态口罩和运动标签的直接监督。 然而,这种说明的成本很高,通常仅限于小规模合成数据集(Karaev等人,2023年;郑等人,2023年)。 仅仅依靠提供损失对动态概率和当地速度造成薄弱的限制,往往导致分解模糊和运动估计不准确。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we adopt an auxiliary distillation strategy . We generate pseudo dynamic masks and optical-flow labels using expert foundation models ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) , and use them as auxiliary supervision during training. This provides scalable guidance on where the scene should be decomposed and how dynamic Gaussians should move, allowing SplatFlux to benefit from large-scale training without costly annotations.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们采取了一项辅助蒸馏战略。 我们利用专家基础模型(Bai等人,2025年;Yuan等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年c)生成伪动态口罩和光学流标,并在培训期间用作辅助监督。 这为场景的分解位置和动态高斯人应如何移动提供了可扩展的指导,使得SplateFlux可以在没有昂贵说明的情况下受益于大规模训练.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We train SplatFlux on 17 public datasets, covering static and dynamic content across object-centric, indoor, and outdoor scenarios. For the 4DGS decoder, we initialize the alternating attention blocks and geometry head from DA3-Giant ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , use the frozen Wan2.1 VAE ( Wan et al., 2025 ) as the latent encoder, and adopt gsplat ( Ye et al., 2025b ) for differentiable rasterization. For each training iteration, we sample T T source frames and T − 1 T-1 intermediate target frames between adjacent source frames. The 4DGS decoder is supervised using the objective in Eq. 11 . For conditional generation, we fine-tune Wan2.1-14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) with the standard flow-matching objective, where training videos are encoded into per-frame latent sequences without temporal compression. The generated conditional latents are directly decoded by the shared 4DGS decoder 𝒟 GS \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{GS}} . The full training pipeline takes approximately 10 days on 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs. Details of the training datasets and implementation are provided in Appendix A and Appendix B , respectively.

blocks.en: 4.1 Dynamic Novel View Synthesis

blocks.en: We evaluate SplatFlux for dynamic novel view synthesis on the NVIDIA Dynamic Scene ( Yoon et al., 2020 ) , DyCheck ( Gao et al., 2022 ) , and DAVIS ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ) datasets. We compare with three state-of-the-art open-sourced approaches ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , and list the results in Table 1 . The results demonstrate that SplatFlux achieves superior dynamic novel view synthesis without relying on camera poses as input. The qualitative comparison in Fig. 3 further shows that our method produces clearer details with fewer rendering artifacts. In contrast, the comparison approaches often suffer from ghosting artifacts in dynamic regions, or exhibit limited generalization ability on in-the-wild scenes. The detailed evaluation protocol can be found in Appendix B .

Qualitative results in Fig. 4 (a) further show that SplatFlux generates scenes that more faithfully match the input text conditions.

Moreover, we note that SplatFlux produces 4D Gaussian scenes that support photorealistic rendering, whereas baselines are limited to generating dynamic point clouds.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.3 违约

blocks.en: We present ablation studies on our static-dynamic decoupled representation and auxiliary supervision using the NVIDIA Dynamic Scene dataset in Table 5 . Removing the decoupled representation causes the largest performance drop, suggesting that explicit static-dynamic separation is essential for complete 4D scene construction. Without this constraint, the model tends to learn an interpolation-like representation from monocular videos, where static structures may be treated as dynamic, leading to incomplete geometry and holes under novel view rendering, as illustrated in Fig. 5 . The two supervision signals further provide complementary constraints for dynamic attributes. Dynamic mask supervision guides where the scene should be decomposed, while optical-flow supervision constrains how dynamic Gaussians should move. Removing either supervision signal degrades performance. Notably, our method does not require perfectly precise pseudo labels, benefiting from the consistency constraints provided by rendering supervision, as shown in Fig. 7 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We have presented SplatFlux, a unified feed-forward latent-to-4DGS framework for video-based 4D reconstruction and conditional 4D generation. By decoding video latents from different sources into a 4D Gaussian representation, SplatFlux provides a shared formulation for captured and generated dynamic content. We further introduce a static-dynamic decoupled 4D Gaussian representation that supports complete 4D scene construction in a feed-forward manner. Through auxiliary distillation from vision-language-guided dynamic masks and optical-flow cues, SplatFlux learns dynamic attributes without costly annotations. Extensive experiments on 3D and 4D reconstruction and generation demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of SplatFlux.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SplateFlux,一个用于基于视频的4D重建以及有条件的4D生成的统一的feed-forward潜在至4DGS框架. 通过将不同来源的视频潜伏物解码成4D高斯代表,SplatFlux为捕获和生成动态内容提供了共享配体. 我们进一步引入了静态动力解耦的4D高斯代表,支持以进取方式完成4D场景建设. 通过视觉语言制导的动态口罩和光学流提示的辅助蒸馏,PlatFlux学会了动态属性而无需昂贵的说明. 关于3D和4D重建与生成的广泛实验证明了SplateFlux的有效性和普遍性.

blocks.en: Table 6 summarizes the 17 datasets used for training SplatFlux. We mainly follow CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025e ) for data preprocessing and filtering. blocks.en: Training of the 4DGS Decoder. To improve generalization, we randomly sample the aspect ratio from 0.5 0.5 to 2.0 2.0 , and resize and crop images while keeping the total number of pixels between 100,000 100{,}000 and 250,000 250{,}000 . The number of source frames T T is randomly sampled from 2 2 to 12 12 . We train the 4DGS decoder in two stages. In the first stage, we disable voxelization-based aggregation and train the decoder for 100 100 K iterations. In the second stage, we enable voxelization-based aggregation to reduce redundant static Gaussians and fine-tune the model for another 50 50 K iterations. We use the AdamW optimizer with a cosine learning rate schedule and linear warm-up. The maximum learning rates of the two stages are set to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , respectively. For the parameters initialized from DA3-Giant ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , we scale the learning rate by 0.1 0.1 .
blocks.zh: 训练4DGS解码器. 为了改进概括性,我们随机抽取了从0.5 0.5到2.0 2.0的宽度比,并调整了大小和裁剪图像,同时将像素总数保持在10万100{,}000到25万250{,}000之间. 源帧 T T 的数量从 2 2 到 12 12 随机抽样. 我们分两个阶段训练4DGS解码器. 在第一阶段,我们禁用基于 voxelization 的集合, 并训练解码器为 100 K 迭代。 在第二阶段,我们允许基于 voxelization 的聚合 减少冗余的静态高斯人 并微调模型 对于另外50K的重复。 我们使用 AdamW 优化器,有 余弦学习速度表 和线性热身。 两个阶段的最高学习率分别确定为1×10−4 1\time 10×4}和1×10×5 1\time 10×5}. 对于从DA3-Giant(Lin等人,2026年)初始化的参数,我们以0.1 0.1.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol for dynamic novel view synthesis. For NVIDIA Dynamic Scene, we select 12 input frames in a round-robin manner across cameras, and test on 12 frames from camera 0. For DyCheck, we sample 64 consecutive timestamps for each scene. We reconstruct from 32 frames sampled every two timestamps from a casually captured video (camera 0), and evaluate on all 64 frames from a fixed-camera video (camera 1) together with the remaining 32 frames from camera 0. For DAVIS, we select 60 scenes for evaluation. For each scene, we sample 48 consecutive frames and split them evenly into 24 input frames and 24 evaluation frames. The image resolutions for NVIDIA Dynamic Scene, DyCheck, and DAVIS are set to 560 × 336 560\times 336 , 336 × 448 336\times 448 , and 560 × 336 560\times 336 , respectively.

blocks.en: C.3 Dynamic Object Segmentation

blocks.en: We evaluate SplatFlux for dynamic object segmentation on the DAVIS ( Perazzi et al., 2016 ) dataset. Quantitative metrics including mean IoU (JM), recall of IoU (JR), mean contour accuracy (FM), and recall of contour accuracy (FR) are reported in Table 9 . SplatFlux achieves the best performance across these metrics, demonstrating its ability to distinguish dynamic regions from static scene content. Qualitative results in Fig. 6 further show that our method produces more accurate and complete dynamic masks.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: SplatFlux currently works in an offline setting and does not support streaming reconstruction or generation. We leave streaming latent decoding to future work.
blocks.zh: SplatFlux目前是在离线设置中工作,不支持流体重建或生成. 我们把潜在的解码留给未来的工作。
